## About
Chanin Mechanical is an air conditioning contractor in Miami Beach. We handle A/C, heating and ventilation for homes and commercial buildings, from new construction to repairs and replacing older systems that aren't working as well as they used to.
We pair current technology with hands-on experience to help you get the system that's right for your space, one that keeps you comfortable and can help lower your monthly utility bills.
Customers rate us 4.8 from 36 reviews on Google. Give us a call on a weekday and tell us what's going on with your system.

## Services
- A/C repair: Diagnosis and repair when your air conditioning stops working or isn't keeping up.
- New air conditioning and heating systems: A completely new air conditioning and heating system, or a new one to replace an older system that isn't working as well as it used to.
- Commercial and residential A/C service: Air conditioning service for homes and commercial properties.
- A/C ducts and installation fixes: One reviewer said we replaced their A/C ducts and corrected installation issues left by another contractor.
- Indoor air quality review: A look at the air quality and ventilation in your space.
- Carrier Edge thermostats: Slim thermostats, programmable or non-programmable, with precise temperature and humidity control.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on commercial buildings?
A: Yes. We service air conditioning for both commercial and residential properties.

Q: Do you offer programmable thermostats?
A: Yes. We offer both programmable and non-programmable thermostats with precise temperature and humidity control.

Q: What does your guarantee cover?
A: Our services and products are backed by a 100% guarantee against defects in workmanship or materials for 12 months from the date of purchase.
